images.filename: Patchwork done on the Wicker Arches in Sheffield, England due to World War 2 Bombing.jpg
images.caption: This image was taken at the Wicker Arches in Sheffield England. The patchwork was done to cover a hole left from Lufftwaffe bombing during the Sheffield Blitz in WW2.
